newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 4.78 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 4.78 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 4.78 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
Bids for the HK$5.0 billion issue totalled HK$18.39 billion, it said.
This was the first of two special 28-day issues to facilitate the implementation of the Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system in early December.
The second tender will be held on December 3.
The HKMA said earlier the decision to launch the issues was in response to the strong demand for short-term bills.
Under the RTGS system, banks can make use of exchange fund bills and notes to obtain interest-free intraday liquidity by carrying out intraday repurchase transactions with the HKMA.
